title: Low-power JFET-input operational amplifier, single

sources.document: TI TL06x low-power JFET-input operational amplifiers datasheet SLOS078N (November 1978, revised August 2023)

pins.name: NC1
pins.text: NC in this revision of the datasheet

pins.name: NC5
pins.text: NC in this revision of the datasheet

functions.text: Operational amplifier: OUT is the amplified difference IN+ minus IN-.

electrical.notes: Supply: +-18 V absolute maximum, +-5 V to +-15 V recommended. TL061C input offset voltage 3 typ / 15 max mV at 25 C; supply current 200 typ / 250 max uA (pages 5-6).

unknown: Pins 1 and 5 are NC in revision N of the datasheet. The card wires pins 1 and 5 (they are in its reading); an older revision of the datasheet that might give them another use (such as offset null) was not read.

behaviour.reason: operational amplifier: an analog part with no logic function.
